meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 当你给它一个 Karpathy 模式的 LLM wiki 知识库目录,它会先检测结构(原始资料、wiki 页、schema 等),再抽取实体、显式与隐式关系并做主题分类,最终保存为 knowledge-graph.json,并自动打开交互式知识图谱面板。
howto.when: 当用户给出 Karpathy 模式 wiki 的目录路径,或让它分析当前目录时触发;该目录须包含 index.md 和多个带 [[wikilink]] 的 .md 文件,也可能有 raw/ 与 schema 等。

say.text: 分析 /home/me/projects/llm-wiki 这个知识库目录
say.note: 会检测结构并生成交互式知识图谱。

say.text: 用 understand-knowledge 分析当前文件夹里的 wiki
say.note: 会以当前目录为目标运行完整分析。

howto.what_en: Given a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki directory, it detects raw/wiki/schema structure, extracts entities plus explicit and implicit relations, clusters topics, saves a knowledge-graph.json, and auto-launches an interactive graph dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user supplies the path to such a wiki or targets the current directory, which must contain index.md and several .md files with wikilinks; raw/ and a schema file may also be present.

say_en.note: Runs detection and builds an interactive graph.

say_en.text: Run /understand-knowledge on the current folder's wiki
say_en.note: Uses the current directory as analysis target.
